extracted.intended_audience: researchers conducting scoping reviews/systematic reviews, evidence synthesisers, and open-science practitioners
extracted.subtask_description: Create/curate a reproducible record of the article selection process for a scoping (or systematic) review, showing which records were retrieved, deduplicated, screened (title/abstract), sought but not retrieved, excluded at full text, and finally included.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial Search Web of Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial Search Web of Science: All records retrieved from the Web of Science database search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the full export/list of records retrieved from Web of Science in a dedicated tab so others can see the exact set of hits obtained from that database (include search date, search string/filters and exported fields where possible).

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial Search PsycInfo
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial Search PycInfo: All records retrieved from the PsycInfo database search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the full export/list of records retrieved from PsycInfo in its own tab, including search query, date, and any applied limits/filters to permit replication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Initial Search after Duplicates Removed
rubrics_metrics.description: Initial Search after Duplicates Removed: Records remaining following duplicate removal.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document the deduplication step explicitly (which fields matched, software or algorithms used, and the number of records removed) and present the post-deduplication record set in a separate tab.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase 1 Excluded (title/abstract screening)
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase 1 Excluded: Records removed after initial screening of titles and abstracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List records excluded at the title/abstract screening stage, ideally with reasons or exclusion codes; keep a clear record to support transparency and allow audit of screening decisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase 1 Included (title/abstract screening)
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase 1 Included: Records retained after initial screening of titles and abstracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the set of records advanced to full-text review from title/abstract screening in its own tab, including identifiers to link back to original search records.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase 1 Not Retrieved
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase 1 Not Retrieved: Records not found.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Document any records for which full text could not be obtained, including attempts made and reasons (e.g., unavailable, behind paywall), so readers understand gaps in retrieval.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase 2 Excluded (full-text review)
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase 2 Excluded: Articles excluded after full-text review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Record each full-text exclusion with a clear reason (eligibility criterion not met, wrong population/intervention/outcome/design, etc.) so exclusions at full-text stage are transparent and reproducible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Phase 2 Included (final included studies)
rubrics_metrics.description: Phase 2 Included: This is the final set of studies included in the scoping review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide the definitive list of included studies (bibliographic details, identifiers, and links where possible) in a tab for direct reuse in synthesis and to show how the final sample was derived.

rubrics_metrics.name: PRISMA flow documentation / stepwise transparency
rubrics_metrics.description: Excel file documenting the article selection process for the scoping review, showing which records were included or excluded at each step of the PRISMA flow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Organize the dataset to mirror the PRISMA flow (identification → screening → eligibility → inclusion), enabling others to trace counts and decisions at each stage; include counts per step and clear linkage between tabs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide machine-readable supplementary dataset (.xlsx) with metadata
rubrics_metrics.description: File format: Excel (.xlsx). Relation to project: Supplementary dataset linked to the preregistered scoping review. Osf_registration_doi and other metadata are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Publish the selection dataset in a widely-used machine-readable format (e.g., .xlsx), include metadata (publication date, publisher, project/registration DOI, subjects, tags), and include a clear license (e.g., CC BY) so others can reuse and reproduce the review process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enable reproducibility and reuse
rubrics_metrics.description: This dataset enables reproducibility of the review process and increases transparency by showing how the final set of included studies was derived.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Supply sufficient detail (search strings, dates, deduplication method, exclusion reasons, links/identifiers, and provenance) so independent researchers can replicate the selection process or reuse the records for related evidence syntheses.
